items.snippet_en: On August 23, 2023, India's Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft successfully landed on the Moon's south pole, making India the first country to achieve this feat. This historic event was met with widespread celebrations across India. Celebrations included cheering, hugging, waving the national flag, distributing sweets, dancing, and setting off firecrackers. The successful landing was a moment of immense national pride and was widely reported by news outlets, including the BBC.
